title: Daily Brief · Thursday
spoken: Brief's up. Three things want you today, and the Northwind renewal is the loud one.
summary: Channel had its best week of the quarter, the Northwind renewal went quiet, and you have a keynote draft due Friday.

sections.heading: Needs you today
lines: Northwind renewal — no reply since the 11th. Ping Dana Reyes.
Keynote draft due Friday; outline exists, slides do not.
Two editor applicants waiting on a yes or no.

sections.heading: Going well
lines: The 'Studio Rebuild' video is pacing 2.3x your median.
Retention past the 30-second mark is up four points.

sections.heading: Background
lines: Storage array back under 70% after the archive pass.
